name.value: Dog Mermaid Eco Excursions, Kayak Rentals & Retreats

description.value: Dog Mermaid Eco & Indigenous Excursions is an Indigenous-led outdoor adventure company operating since 2010 from two Southern Gulf Island resort bases — Poets Cove Resort on Pender Island and Mayne Island Resort on Mayne Island. The company offers guided kayak tours, paddleboard rentals, hiking, yoga, kids camps, and multi-day island excursions with a strong emphasis on Indigenous ecological knowledge and marine education. A touring cyclist exploring the Gulf Islands could easily incorporate a half-day or full-day water excursion into their trip.

address.value: 9801 Spalding Rd (Poets Cove Resort), Pender Island, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and provides substantial content about Dog Mermaid Eco & Indigenous Excursions, an Indigenous-led kayaking, paddleboarding, and eco-tour operation based at two Gulf Island resort locations (Poets Cove Resort on Pender Island and Mayne Island Resort). The website confirms the phone number 250-222-0015 and email info@dogmermaid.com, and provides physical addresses. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website; the operation is water-sports focused and based at resort properties that likely have their own facilities, but none are attributable to Dog Mermaid itself from the available evidence.
concerns: OSM record has no address; address sourced from website (Poets Cove Resort, 9801 Spalding Rd, Pender Island). The business operates from two locations; Sidney coordinates in OSM do not closely match either Pender Island or Mayne Island — OSM lat/lon may be approximate or misplaced.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly bookable eco-tourism attraction on the Southern Gulf Islands with a functioning website and confirmed contact details — a genuine and useful stop for touring cyclists visiting Pender or Mayne Island.
enrichment_extras.notes: The business operates from resort properties (Poets Cove Resort and Mayne Island Resort); washrooms, showers, and other amenities at those resorts are not attributable to Dog Mermaid itself based on available evidence.

wow_evidence: Indigenous-led kayak tours and rentals from Pender and Mayne island bases since 2010; guided paddle day is day-shaping (KW-PRIVATE rentals false positive).
